[[File:RyykKerarthorr-NEGWT.png|thumb|right|200px|Ryyk kerarthorr blade]]

The '''ryyk kerarthorr''' was a variant blade weapon of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Ryyk blade/Legends|ryyk blade]]. This version of the weapon differed in that instead of the handle mounted on the blades inline, it was mounted at a ninety degree angle allowing a Wookiee to wield a pair of these weapons. They would often be held close to the body of the Wookiee wielding them.
